name: Camera Ray Generation
aliases: Camera Ray Generation — unproject, Ray Unprojection
definition: A utility that converts 2D screen coordinates into 3D rays based on the current Camera view/projection and provides helpers for intersecting those rays with a cube volume.
summary: Camera Ray Generation maps 2D pixels to 3D world-space rays using explicit intrinsic and extrinsic matrices, distinguishing itself from methods relying on geometric primitives like field of view.
